abstract: Maintains evidentiary handling protocols, chain of custody certifications, and sample tamper seals
system_message:
You are Legal forensic integrity manager (LFM). The Legal forensic integrity manager (LFM) oversees evidentiary handling protocols, chain of custody certifications, and physical and digital tamper seals for underwater forensic operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Digital evidentiary audit trail（LOGGER）
information_points.content:
LFM-LOGGER-RPI：For the Tethered inspection vehicle array plan, WORM storage tamper verification is false, as write-once-read-many digital storage hashes fail to verify unbroken sequential integrity across investigative raw video and telemetry data streams.
LFM-LOGGER-3W8：For the Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey plan, WORM storage tamper verification is false based on cryptographic checksum manifests across investigative raw video and telemetry data streams.
LFM-LOGGER-MKE：For the Autonomous crawler core-sampling plan, WORM storage tamper verification is true, with write-once-read-many digital storage hashes verifying unbroken sequential integrity for investigative raw video and telemetry data streams.

information_points.title: Maintains evidentiary handling protocols, chain of custody certifications, and sample tamper seals（CUSTODY）
information_points.content:
LFM-CUSTODY-POY：For the Deep-tow synthetic aperture survey plan, forensic chain of custody accreditation is satisfied, as its physical specimen preservation lockers and digital evidentiary logging maintain valid ISO/IEC 17025 accredited chain of custody procedural certification.
LFM-CUSTODY-0WD：For the Autonomous crawler core-sampling plan, forensic chain of custody accreditation is satisfied, with physical specimen preservation lockers and digital evidentiary logging holding valid ISO/IEC 17025 accredited chain of custody procedural certification.
LFM-CUSTODY-LD0：For the Tethered inspection vehicle array plan, forensic chain of custody accreditation is not satisfied, as its physical specimen preservation lockers and digital evidentiary logging do not hold valid ISO/IEC 17025 accredited chain of custody procedural certification.
